groups.title: D11 — the calendar nudge window is never retried, so total, round and until with a calendar smallestUnit answer over the wrong bounds (relativeTo on the 29th-31st)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains js-temporal/temporal-polyfill#361's 50d66d2, which ports proposal-temporal #3172 (5dd0b0d97ee1, the fix for tc39 #3168) and retries the nudge window; merged to main in PR #361 as 5af905f, so no new filing is needed

groups.title: D12 — a zoned string's offset written with seconds is matched by minutes instead of exactly (zonedWallClock.ts defect 4)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 23d1275 ("Normative: Require strict matching with a precise ZonedDateTime offset", on main)

groups.title: D13 — two offset changes inside one 14-day transition search step are skipped, or stall the search for ever (zonedWallClock.ts defect 5)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release on which EVERY D13 probe returns the spec value, the stall.* probes within 20,000 offset reads. a79c6a1 (per-zone search windows, on main, in no release) alone is not enough: its 17-day window for Africa/El_Aaiun holds three offsets in April 1976, so stall.nextElAaiun fails there (not filed)

groups.title: D14 — ZonedDateTime#round to the day does not clamp an instant in the second piece of a date that starts twice (zonedWallClockOperations.ts roundZonedDateTime)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release that ports the day-round clamp of tc39/ecma262#3966 (commit 5f44331e0a11) (tc39/proposal-temporal#3312; reference polyfill commit 59a51ea9d4); Node 26's V8 throws RangeError on the probe. Expected value: test262 intl402/Temporal/ZonedDateTime/prototype/round/same-date-starts-twice.js

groups.title: D15 — `Z` string read by wall clock under offset: "ignore" instead of as an exact instant (zonedWallClock.ts defect 6)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release (and Node floor) whose ToTemporalZonedDateTime keeps a Z string's own instant under offset: "ignore", as InterpretISODateTimeOffset requires. Native V8 (Node 24.21 with --harmony-temporal) shares the defect; not filed upstream yet, and js-temporal main c55b211 and tc39 main e8cc03f both still have it (bug doc § O). The expected value is the specification's

groups.title: D16 — formatRange drops O and long zone-name widths (ICU-20548)
groups.trigger: an ICU release that fixes ICU-20548 is bundled by GMT's engines.node floor (>=22.16.0) and by every browser the native suite runs, so every D16 repro passes on every engine: this check reports Node, and the weekly run's compat check in each browser (the temporal-compat-chromium, -firefox and -webkit verdicts) reports the rest; D16 is removable only when all of them say so

groups.title: D17 — formatRange writes AM/PM for a flexible dayPeriod next to a timeZoneName (SpiderMonkey)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in Firefox (the temporal-compat-firefox verdict) reports D17 removable: every D17 repro passes in the Firefox the native suite runs, once Bugzilla 2085525 ships. Firefox is the only engine in D17's scope; this check runs on Node, where D17 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D18 — Islamic calendar dates before the Hijra read as positive years in a second era (WebKit)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in WebKit (the temporal-compat-webkit verdict) reports D18 removable: every D18 repro passes in the WebKit the native suite runs, once a js-temporal release reads the Islamic eras or WebKit prints the year as V8 does. WebKit is the only engine in D18's scope; this check runs on Node, where D18 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D9 — non-ISO months added and counted one month at a time (heap OOM for in-range amounts; temporalCompat/largeMonthSpan.ts)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release adds and differences non-ISO months in bounded work: each D9 probe reads at most 100 Intl dates for 1,200 months

groups.title: zoned.A — wall clock → exact time at the range limits (zonedWallClock.ts defect 1, zonedWallClockDifference.ts defect 1)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 05ce7a3 (the max.* probes) and 95237e0 (the min.* probes); both are on main

groups.title: zoned.B — next transition missed near the maximum (zonedWallClock.ts defect 2)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release fixes GetNamedTimeZoneNextTransition near the maximum (upstream-issue draft B; not fixed on main)

groups.title: zoned.E — transition search floored at 1847-01-01 (zonedWallClock.ts defect 3)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release containing js-temporal/temporal-polyfill#372 (tc39/proposal-temporal#3330)

groups.title: zoned.D — UTC fast path skips IsValidEpochNanoseconds (zonedWallClockDifference.ts defect 2)
